messages:
kelsey: Quick sync — noticed our error-ref is fragmented across multiple pages for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Can we consolidate into one canonical troubleshooting page and update SDK snippets?
sofia: I can take the canonical page. I sketched a TOC in the PR description: symptoms, root causes, short-term fallbacks, SDK examples, links to runtimes.
prashant: Awesome. Can you add a small matrix mapping error codes -> recommended fallback (e.g., 429 -> backoff+smaller batch, timeout -> retry w/ idempotency)? That was missing in my last pass.
ali: Also need to make sure node/python SDK snippets show how to parse `Retry-After` and `x-rate-limit-*` headers. Lots of customers rely on header-based windows.
sofia: yep. I added a minimal snippet for parsing `Retry-After`. Putting it here for review:```python
# parse Retry-After header
import math
retry = response.headers.get('Retry-After')
delay = int(retry) if retry and retry.isdigit() else math.ceil(backoff_base)
```
prashant: For node I'll mirror that. Also added an example showing exponential backoff with jitter and a capped attempts param.
ali: Important: show an example fallback that trims context rather than immediate retry — some teams prefer trimming to avoid request duplication. Maybe show before/after prompt sizes.
kelsey: Good call. Can we make the SDK snippets small (6-10 lines) and link to a full-sample repo for expanded patterns? I want the docs digestible.
sofia: Done. I linked to `github.com/redwood-inference/examples/backoff-and-trim` in the PR.
docs-bot: PR opened: #3421 by sofia — "consolidate-error-ref-fragmentation + sdk snippets" (labels: docs, urgent)
prashant: Quick nit: in the table of fallbacks, use consistent terminology: `trim_context`, `retry_with_backoff`, `switch_model_variant`. Some pages used different verbs which confused readers.
sofia: fixed wording in commit 3.
ali: UX ask — please add a one-line note for hosted vs dedicated behavior (e.g., dedicated may return different rate-limit headers). That prevents mistaken assumptions.
kelsey: Yes include deployment note. Also schedule a docs review tomorrow 10am PT? @prashant @ali please attend.
prashant: I can make that.
ali: I'll be there.
kelsey: Final: once PR is green, we should add a short changelog entry and ping #support with the consolidated link. Thanks all :rocket:
